Submit - Some cleaning up and corrections. First, corrections: in general, I tried to combine them into as few blocks as possible, but feel free to reallocate. I have not changed every little bracket or abbreviation to conform to modern editions (e.g. κ(αί) --> καί), as this would severely overload the apparatus. Reading notes: οὐλή is abbreviated, as often, with a line over omicron; for the ἀριστερός symbol, see BASP 50, p. 88; Herakleides looks to have two scars in l. 1 (only one in the body text), the second beginning χ (neither χειρί nor χείλει, however spelled, looked convincing); καρπ( ) is written καρ) with curved pi raised; the abbrev. μετὰ κ(υρίου) with raised kappa is common (same kappa is found in Ἡρακ( ), passim, which I changed for the sake of consistency). Also added one note of comm. Housekeeping: Fixed line numbering error where end of l. 26 was made to be l. 27 and renumbered accordingly. Accents: corrected to ποδεί, l. 3; added accent to νότον l. 6; βασιλικῆι, αὐλῆι l. 8; Ἡράκλε̣ι̣τος instead of Ἡρακλε̣ί̣τος, l. 18 (that’s indeed what scribe wrote, not Ἡρακλείτης – I’ve left ed.’s tentative dots even though ει is clear). BL: fixed Wilcken’s correction in l. 1, which BL 1.259 reported incorrectly; added BL attribution to l. 7 (and left the ξ dotted b/c only traces remain), l. 16, l. 17. Incorrection expansions / transcription: l. 16 ὑποτιθ(εμένην) --> ὑποτιθ(έντας); ἐξαλλοτριω(μένην) --> ἐξαλλοτριο(ύντας); l. 24 ἀπηλιώ[τ(ην)] --> ἀπηλιώ[τ(ου)] (the papyrus itself has ἀπηλιότου, as in l. 21, which I’ve corrected). Added reg τε --> δέ in l. 25, πρόκιται --> πρόκειται, l. 27.

item.p: Κόραξ Ἀπολλωνίου: This ὑπογραφεύς is also found in P.Athen. 25 (Karanis, 61 CE), where his age is given as 30 (Claytor).
